ValidationRule.description: Requires Cloud Provider to be populated when Primary Product Line is Digitization from Stage 2 onward through Closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validation),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard_Opportunity", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Framework_Parent_Opportunity" ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, "New Deal"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Renewal"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Cross-Sell/Upsell") ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "High Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "Medium Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "Low Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "No Touch") ),
ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "Digital"),
OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Solutioning"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Negotiation") ), IF( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Framework_Parent_Opportunity", AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booked") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booking Verification") ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Booking Verification"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booked") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Booked"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Setup") ), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed") ),
ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, "Digitization"), ISPICKVAL(Cloud_Provider__c, "") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a Cloud Provider since Primary Product Line is Digitization. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
